items.title: nutlope/hallmark - 2,859 stars today, now the top repo on the page
items.summary:
hallmark is a css design skill that gives claude code, cursor and codex hard rules so generated pages stop looking like default ai output.
it took the top slot with 2,859 stars in 24 hours and sits on 38,361 total, with commits still landing at 15:05 utc.

items.title: hkuds/deeptutor - 1,587 stars for a personal tutor that keeps a long memory
items.summary:
deeptutor is a tutoring agent from the hku data science lab built around lifelong, personalised teaching rather than one-off answers.
1,587 stars today put it on 45,358 total, and the repo was pushed again at 16:00 utc.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable - 1,458 stars for a design language an agent can load
items.summary:
impeccable ships a shared design vocabulary that a coding agent reads instead of guessing at spacing, type and colour.
it held fourth with 1,458 stars today on 90,151 total, and the rust repo was pushed at 15:58 utc.

items.title: makecindy/cindy - 1,446 stars for an agent that works without a setup evening
items.summary:
cindy is pitched at people who want an agent that runs tasks out of the box rather than one they wire together themselves.
1,446 stars today took it to 7,270 total, a smaller base than the design repos above it, and it was pushed at 15:45 utc.

items.title: jetbrains/thinkrail - 1,211 stars for a lightweight ide that reshapes itself
items.summary:
thinkrail is jetbrains' bet that vibe coding still wants a real editor, with the layout adapting to how each person works.
1,211 stars today took it to 3,709 total, and the repo shipped commits at 15:58 utc.

items.title: affaan-m/ecc - 1,183 stars for harness tuning across every coding agent
items.summary:
ecc collects skills, memory, security rules and a research-first workflow meant to be dropped into claude code, codex, opencode or cursor.
1,183 stars today held it on the page at 290,528 total, one of the largest repos in the ranking.

items.title: gitroomhq/postiz-app - 953 stars for scheduling social posts with agents
items.summary:
postiz is an open-source scheduler that now advertises agentic posting across social accounts from one queue.
953 stars today took it to 39,046 total, a mature repo rather than a launch spike, last pushed on 24 october.

items.title: nightly-labs/openbot - 794 stars for a local-first desk for ai teammates
items.summary:
openbot runs codex, claude and grok in separate workspaces with task queues, shared files, browser control and agent-to-agent handoff.
794 stars today put it on 2,092 total, and it was pushed at 16:01 utc, the freshest repo on the page.

items.title: houthis claim a missile hit on ras tanura, saudi coalition reports interceptions
items.summary:
the houthis say they struck the ras tanura refinery and the saudi defence ministry, and a fire broke out near the export terminal before it was contained.
the saudi-led coalition says it intercepted three ballistic missiles and four drones over the eastern province and the south with no casualties, so the refinery damage claim is still unconfirmed.
items.change: first houthi claim on saudi export infrastructure this week, and the coalition's interception count for the same wave of fire.

items.title: israel votes with record turnout as netanyahu fights for his majority
items.summary:
israelis are voting in an election that has become a referendum on netanyahu, and turnout reached almost 45% by the afternoon, the highest in 50 years.
polls close at 10pm local (20:00 gmt) with exit polls soon after, but the last surveys had his bloc on 50 seats against 54 for eisenkot's opposition and coalition talks could run for weeks.
items.change: turnout is running six points above 2022 and heading for a record, with netanyahu still short of the 61 seats a coalition needs.

items.title: mecca pact talks end with a promise of more talks, and china sends an envoy
items.summary:
saudi, turkish and pakistani officials left tehran saying they would keep talking, and iran's security chief met the supreme leader after the talks the same day.
tehran still ties reopening hormuz to sanctions relief, an end to the naval blockade on its ports and guarantees against new attacks, while beijing says it will send its own envoy to the region.
items.change: the mecca pact delegation produced another round of talks rather than a deal, and china added itself to the mediation track.

items.title: egypt authorises military support for saudi arabia and turkey clears the riyadh pact
items.summary:
egypt's parliament voted to let the state give saudi arabia military support, and a turkish parliamentary committee cleared the saudi-pakistan defence pact for ratification.
the formal military backing behind riyadh widened on the same day the diplomacy track was still running in tehran.
items.change: egypt's vote and turkey's committee approval both landed inside a day, widening the formal military backing behind riyadh.

items.title: jordan says it killed 20-plus militants in syria, damascus shuts the nasib crossing
items.summary:
jordan says its jets destroyed islamic state hideouts in southern syria and killed more than 20 fighters, retaliation for the karak church attack that killed nine.
damascus calls the strikes a treacherous attack carried out without coordination and says eight civilians died, and the main nasib border crossing with jordan is now closed.
items.change: jordan put a number on the operation while syria raised its civilian toll from seven to eight and shut the main border crossing between them.

items.title: un inquiry accuses israel of extermination in the west bank and genocide in gaza
items.summary:
a un commission of inquiry says israeli forces committed crimes against humanity in the occupied west bank, including extermination, torture and rape, and are still committing genocide in gaza.
it counted 254 palestinians killed in west bank air strikes since 7 october 2023 against six in the previous 15 years, and treated settler violence as part of a systematic attack on civilians.
items.change: the report is new and lands on election day: a un inquiry now formally accuses israel of extermination in the west bank, not only in gaza.

items.title: eleven killed in gaza in 24 hours, including four in a tent camp
items.summary:
gaza's civil defence says 11 people were killed and 50 wounded in the past day, with the deadliest strike on a camp for displaced people in al-mawasi.
a drone hit on a tent in gaza city's remal neighbourhood killed one more, according to wafa.
items.change: no revised toll since this morning; the displacement-camp strikes remain the active thread.

items.title: s&p 500 up 0.75% at midday, nasdaq leads as vix drops under 18
items.summary:
us stocks are higher at midday with the s&p 500 at 7,734.57, up 0.75%, and the nasdaq composite up 1.35% at 26,522.01 as chips lead, amd up 5.3%.
the dow is up 0.21% at 52,470, the vix has fallen 4.6% to 17.55, the russell 2000 is up 0.93% and gold is 0.95% higher at $4,076.70.

items.title: fed starts its two-day meeting with a hold priced and hikes still on the table
items.summary:
the federal reserve opens a two-day meeting today with markets expecting no change to rates after september's increase, and the decision lands tomorrow at 2pm et.
the question is what kevin warsh says about the next move, with traders watching for a signal that further hikes rather than cuts are the bias.

items.title: boeing sinks 9.6% on a 737 delay while coca-cola and ups raise guidance
items.summary:
boeing fell 9.6% after saying it will not significantly ramp 737 max output until late 2027, and coca-cola slipped 0.5% despite lifting its full-year outlook.
ups rose 3.1% on a beat and another guidance raise, royal caribbean jumped 8% on a q3 beat and higher 2026 outlook, hsbc fell 6% even after a 32% profit jump, hca lost 4.5% despite beating, and visa reports after the close.

items.title: oil falls anyway: brent 109.42 and wti 100.05 despite the refinery claim
items.summary:
brent is down 1.2% at $109.42 and wti down 1.7% at $100.05 even after the houthi claim on ras tanura, with the tehran talks still running.
the war premium has been bleeding out for two sessions, so one unconfirmed strike claim has not been enough to turn it while diplomats are still talking.

items.title: nvidia and amd put $4bn into meta as it raises $95bn for ai buildout
items.summary:
nvidia and amd will invest $4bn in meta, deepening the chipmakers' partnership with the company that is buying their accelerators.
meta said on monday it would raise $95bn to fund ai infrastructure, a reminder that the capex cycle behind the chip trade is still expanding.

items.title: anthropic's ipo is being read as the market's test of the ai trade
items.summary:
anthropic's filing is out and coverage has turned to the risks listed in the s-1 rather than the pitch.
with the ai trade sputtering and rates rising, the listing is being read as a referendum on the whole complex rather than on one company.

items.title: gold at $4,076 and the 10-year pinned near 5% into the fed
items.summary:
gold is up 0.95% at $4,076.70 an ounce and the dollar index is 0.28% firmer at 102.25 while the 10-year yield holds at 4.99%.
gold and the dollar both bid into a fed meeting, with the 10-year near 5% keeping the rate path the main thing traders are hedging.

items.title: chelsea at anfield on wednesday, 8pm uk, with xabi alonso back on the touchline
items.summary:
liverpool host chelsea in the carabao cup fourth round on wednesday at 8pm uk time, the sixth game in a run of nine in 29 days.
iraola is expected to rotate: mamardashvili in goal, araujo possibly rested before arsenal, and joe gomez at right-back with frimpong out.

items.title: wirtz should be fit for chelsea, szoboszlai and munoz look short
items.summary:
iraola says he is quite optimistic florian wirtz will be available after the ankle knock that forced him off against brighton.
dominik szoboszlai and victor munoz have missed two games and the manager would not rule them out, but called both more difficult than wirtz.

items.title: chelsea lose joao pedro for weeks, but emegha can debut at anfield
items.summary:
xabi alonso confirmed joao pedro has a thigh injury that will keep him out for several weeks, a blow to a chelsea side already short of attacking fluency.
summer signing emmanuel emegha is fit after a hamstring problem and could make his debut on wednesday.

items.title: arsenal at anfield on sunday, then fenerbahce away the following midweek
items.summary:
after chelsea, liverpool face arsenal at anfield in the premier league on sunday before travelling to fenerbahce the following wednesday.
it is the back half of nine games in 29 days, which is why iraola is talking about video sessions instead of full training weeks.

items.title: chiesa is the wildcard again as iraola weighs his cup XI
items.summary:
federico chiesa is being talked up for a first start of the season in the carabao cup tie, with the squad squeezed by injuries and the arsenal game three days later.
the echo reports it as a selection possibility rather than a decision, and iraola said he would use the final training day before choosing.

items.title: araujo's loan is turning into a £47m decision, and he may sit out chelsea
items.summary:
ronald araujo has gone from squad filler to a player the club is weighing a £47m permanent move for, and his celebration has become a fan favourite.
the flip side is workload: with arsenal on sunday, the echo expects him to be rested against chelsea, which puts gomez at right-back.

items.title: carragher wants trent alexander-arnold back, but it is punditry not a rumour
items.summary:
jamie carragher says trent alexander-arnold made a big mistake joining real madrid and would welcome him back at liverpool.
the case is form: 22 starts last season, out of england's world cup squad, and benched for four of madrid's last six games, but no club source has put a move on the table.

meta.reliability: pundit opinion, no club interest reported
